1.1: Blessed is the man who walks not in the counsel of the wicked, nor stands in the way of sinners.
1.2: Do not sit in the seat of arrogants.
1.3: But delight in the law of the Lord
1.4: He meditates on his law day and night.
1.5: He is like a tree planted by streams of water, which yields its fruit in its season.
1.6: Like a leaf that never withers, so everything he does will prosper.
1.8: Only like the chaff that the wind blows
1.9: Therefore the wicked will not endure judgment;
1.10: Sinners will not enter into the assembly of the righteous.
1.11: The way of the righteous is acceptable to the LORD, but the way of the wicked will be destroyed.

2.1: Why do foreign countries become angry and why do peoples plot vain things?
2.2: The kings of the world took action, and the rulers took counsel together.
2.3: Against Jehovah and against his anointed.
2.4: Let us break their bands in pieces and throw away their bonds.
2.5: He who is in heaven laughs
2.6: The Lord will laugh at them.
2.7: Then he was angry and startled them in his anger, saying,
2.8: I have set my King on Zion, my holy hill.
2.9: I speak the commandment of the LORD; the LORD said to me,
2.10: You are my son; today I have begotten you.
2.11: Ask of me, and I will give you the nations for your inheritance.
2.12: Your possessions will extend to the ends of the earth.

3.1: Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness; you have been generous to me in times of trouble.
3.2: Be gracious to me and hear my prayer.
3.3: O sons of men, how long will you turn my glory into profanity?
3.4: Do you like vain things and seek lies?
3.5: Know ye that the LORD hath chosen for himself a godly man.
3.6: The LORD will hear when I call to him.
3.7: Tremble, and do not sin; lie down, speak in your hearts, and be still.
3.8: Offer a sacrifice of righteousness and trust in the Lord.
3.9: Many say, ‘Who is he that will show us good?’
3.10: Lift up your face, O LORD, and make it shine on us.
3.11: The joy you have placed in my heart
3.12: Their grain and new wine are greater than when they abounded.
3.13: I will lie down and sleep in peace.
3.14: It is the Lord who makes me live in safety.

4.1: Listen to me, O LORD, and consider my heart.
4.2: Hear my cry, O my King and my God; I pray to you.
4.3: In the morning, O LORD, you will hear my voice; in the morning I will pray and wait for you.
4.4: You are not a god who delights in iniquity; evil cannot remain with you.
4.5: The arrogant will not stand in your presence; you hate all evildoers.
4.6: He will destroy those who lie. The Lord hates bloodthirsty people and deceivers.
4.7: But because of the abundance of your love, I will enter your house and worship in your fear toward your temple.
4.8: Guide me, O LORD, in your righteousness because of my enemies; make your ways straight before my eyes.

5.1: Jehovah our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!
5.2: Your glory has covered the heavens.
5.3: Because of your adversaries, you have established power through the mouths of babes and infants.
5.4: That the enemies and avengers may be silenced.
5.5: Your heavens, the work of your fingers,
5.6: I see the moon and the stars, which You have provided.
5.7: What is man that you remember him?
5.8: And what is the Son of man, that thou shouldest care for him?
5.9: Make him a little lower than God.
5.10: You are crowned with glory and honor.
5.11: He gave him dominion over the works of his hands; he put all things under his feet.
5.12: All cattle, sheep, and wild animals, the birds of the air, the fish of the sea, and all that walks along the sea.
5.13: O LORD our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!

6.1: Arise, O LORD; lift up your hand, O God; and do not forget the poor.
6.2: Why does the wicked despise God, saying in his heart, “Thou will not watch?”
6.3: Thou hast seen, Thou seest the calamity and the vengeance, and seekest to repay with Thine hand.
6.4: The lonely trust in you; you are already the helper of the fatherless.
6.5: Break the arm of the wicked. Search for the evil of the wicked until he can no longer be found.
6.6: The LORD is king forever and ever; the nations have perished from your land.
6.7: O LORD, you have heard the desire of the humble.
6.8: Prepare their hearts and listen carefully.
6.9: Judge for the orphans and the oppressed.
6.10: He will not allow anyone from the world to threaten again.

7.1: How long, O LORD, will you forget me forever?
7.2: How long will you hide your face from me?
7.3: How long will my soul be troubled and troubled in my heart all day long?
7.4: How long shall my enemy boast against me?
7.5: Consider me, O LORD my God, and answer me; enlighten my eyes.
7.6: I am afraid lest I fall into the sleep of death.
7.7: Lest my enemy say, ‘I have overcome him.’
7.8: Lest my enemies rejoice when I am shaken.
7.9: I have trusted only in your love.
7.10: My heart will rejoice in your salvation.
7.11: I will praise the LORD, for he has been good to me.

8.1: The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.”
8.2: They are corrupt and their ways are abominable; there is no one who does good.
8.3: The Lord looked down from heaven on all mankind to see if there were any who understood and sought after God.
8.4: They have all gone aside, they have all become unclean, and there is no one who does good, not even one.
8.5: Are all those who practice iniquity ignorant? They eat my people like bread, but they do not call on the LORD.
8.6: But there they feared and were afraid: for God is in the generation of the righteous.
8.7: You put to shame the plans of the poor, but the Lord is his refuge.
8.8: May the salvation of Israel come out of Zion.
8.9: Jacob will rejoice and Israel will rejoice, when the LORD returns his people from their captivity.

9.1: Who may stay in Your tent, O LORD?
9.2: Who dwell in thy holy mountain?
9.4: Speak the truth to his heart
9.5: He will not trespass against another with his tongue or do evil to his neighbor.
9.6: He shall not slander his neighbor.
9.7: His eyes despise a profane person;
9.8: Honor those who fear the Lord.
9.9: The vow of his heart will not change, even if it is harmful.
9.10: He does not lend money to collect interest.
9.11: He who takes a bribe and does not harm the innocent.
9.12: He who does these things will never be moved.

10.1: Protect me, O God, for in you I take refuge.
10.2: I said to the LORD, “You are my Lord; apart from you I have no good.”
10.3: The saints on earth are noble; all my pleasure is in them.
10.4: Those who offer gifts to other gods will have increased suffering.
10.5: I will not offer their blood offering;
10.6: Neither will my lips utter his name.
10.7: The LORD is my inheritance and the portion of my cup; he keeps my portion.
10.8: The territory you have measured out for me is in a good place; my inheritance is indeed good.
10.9: Praise the Lord, who has disciplined me.
10.10: Night after night my conscience instructs me.
10.11: I have set the LORD always before me;
10.12: Because he is at my right hand, I will not be moved.

11.1: Hear, O LORD, the appeal of righteousness; pay attention to my cry.
11.2: Listen to my prayer from lips that do not lie.
11.3: You judge me; let your eyes see justice.
11.4: You tried my heart; you came to me by night and tried me.
11.5: Since you found no fault with me, my resolve will not be with my mouth to sin.
11.6: As for the works of man, I am careful to follow the words of your lips.
11.7: I have not walked in the path of the violent.
11.8: My steps have been steadfast in your ways; I have not stumbled.
11.9: I have called, O God, for you will answer me.
11.10: Give ear to me and hear what I say.
11.11: O Lord, with your right hand you save those who take refuge in you from those who rise up against them.

12.1: The heavens declare the glory of God
12.2: The firmament shows the work of his hands.
12.3: Day to day speaks, and night to night gives knowledge; there is no language, no word, no sound.
12.4: His voice goes out into all the earth, and his words to the ends of the earth.
12.5: The law of the LORD is perfect, reviving the soul.
12.6: The testimonies of the LORD are sure, making wise the simple.
12.7: The precepts of the LORD are right, rejoicing the heart;
12.8: The commandments of the LORD are pure, illuminating the eyes.
12.9: The fear of the Lord is pure and endures forever.
12.10: The law of the LORD is true and righteous in all.
12.11: Gold is more to be desired than much pure gold; it is sweeter than honey and the honey of the honeycomb.

13.3: He makes me lie down in green pastures;
13.4: He leads us beside still waters.
13.6: He guides us in paths of righteousness for His name’s sake.
13.7: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil.
13.8: You are with me; your staff and your staff comfort me.
13.9: You prepare a table for me in the presence of my enemies.
13.10: You have poured oil on my head; my cup is overflowing.
13.11: Surely goodness and mercy will follow me all the days of my life.
13.12: I will dwell in the house of the Lord forever.

14.1: The earth is the Lord's, and everything in it, the world and those who live in it.
14.2: The LORD has established his foundation on the seas; he has built him on the rivers.
14.3: Who shall ascend the mountain of the LORD, and who shall stand in his holy place?
14.4: He who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not set his mind on vain things and does not swear falsely.
14.5: He will receive a blessing from the LORD and righteousness from the God of his salvation.
14.6: This is a people who seek the LORD, who seek the face of the God of Jacob.
14.7: Lift up your heads, O gates; be lifted up, O gates of eternity; for the King of glory shall enter in.
14.8: Who is the King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
14.9: Lift up your heads, O gates; be lifted up, O gates of eternity; for the King of glory shall enter in.
14.10: Who is the King of glory? The Lord Almighty is the King of glory.

15.1: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear?
15.2: The LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I fear?
15.3: The wicked came to me to eat my flesh;
15.4: My adversaries, my enemies, have stumbled and fallen.
15.5: Though an army besiege me, my heart will not fear;
15.6: Even if war breaks out against me, I will still be calm.
15.7: One thing I have desired from the LORD, that I will seek; I will dwell in the LORD's house all the days of my life.
15.8: To behold the beauty of the LORD, and to long for it in his temple.
15.9: The LORD will keep me secret in his tabernacle in the day of trouble;
15.10: He will hide me in the secret place of his tent; he will set me on a high rock.
15.11: Now my head will be lifted up above my enemies who surround me.
15.12: I will offer a joyous sacrifice in his tent; I will sing and praise the LORD.

16.1: I cry to you, O LORD; stop your ear to me, O my rock!
16.2: If you were silent about me, I would be like one who goes down to the grave.
16.3: When I lifted up my hands toward Your Most Holy Place and cried out to You,
16.4: Hear the voice of my supplication
16.5: Do not drag me away with the wicked and evildoers.
16.6: They speak peace to their neighbors, but malice is in their hearts.
16.7: For they consider not the works of the LORD, nor the works of his hands;
16.8: The Lord will destroy them and not build them up.
16.10: For he hears the voice of my supplications.
16.11: The LORD is my strength and my shield;
16.12: My soul trusts in him and finds help.
16.13: The LORD is their strength, the fortress of the salvation of his anointed.

17.1: Give and give glory and power to the Lord, you who are mighty.
17.2: Give to the LORD the glory due his name; worship the LORD in holy clothing.
17.3: The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory thunders; the LORD is over many waters.
17.4: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is majestic.
17.5: The voice of the LORD breaks down the cedars; the LORD breaks the cedars of Lebanon and crushes them.
17.6: He makes the tree leap like a calf; he makes Lebanon and Sirion leap like wild calves.
17.7: The voice of the Lord splits the flames.
17.8: The voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness; the LORD shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.
17.9: The voice of the LORD causes the hind to give birth and leaves the forest bare.
17.10: In his temple all his things say, “Glory!”
17.11: The LORD sat on the throne in the flood; the LORD sits on the throne forever.
17.12: The LORD will give strength to his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.

18.1: In you, O LORD, I put my trust; do not put me to shame forever, but deliver me in your righteousness.
18.2: Heed me and deliver me quickly; be to me a rock of strength and a stronghold of salvation.
18.3: You are my rock and my fortress; therefore, consider your name and guide me and guide me.
18.4: Pull me out of the net they have spread for me secretly, for you are my stronghold.
18.5: Into your hands I commit my spirit; you have redeemed me, O LORD, God of truth.
18.6: I hate those who worship empty lies, and I trust in the LORD.
18.7: I will rejoice and rejoice in your lovingkindness, for you have seen my affliction and have known my soul in my affliction.
18.8: For you have not confined me into the power of the enemy; you have set my feet in a spacious place.

19.1: Blessed are those whose transgressions are forgiven and whose sins are covered.
19.2: Blessed is he whose heart is not deceitful, and who is not condemned by the Lord.
19.3: My bones wasted away through my groaning all day long, when I did not open my mouth.
19.4: Your hand is upon me day and night; my essence has drained away, and I have become dry in the summer drought.
19.5: I confessed my sin to the Lord, and my iniquity was not hid from me.
19.7: Because of this, all the devout will have an opportunity to meet the Lord and pray to the Lord.
19.8: Verily, though the flood shall overflow, it shall not reach him.
19.9: You are my hiding place; protect me from trouble.
19.10: You will surround me with songs of salvation
19.11: Rejoice and be glad in the LORD, you righteous ones!
19.12: Shout for joy, all you upright in heart.

20.1: Rejoice in the Lord, you righteous ones; praise is proper for the upright.
20.2: Give thanks to the Lord with the harp and sing praises with the ten-stringed harp.
20.3: Sing to him with a new song and play beautifully with joyful sounds.
20.4: The word of the LORD is right, and all his works are truthful.
20.5: He loves justice and righteousness; the earth is full of the lovingkindness of the Lord.
20.6: By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, and by the breath of his mouth all their hosts were made.
20.7: He gathers the waters of the sea together into a heap; he puts the deep into a treasury.
20.8: Let all the earth fear the LORD, and let all the inhabitants of the earth fear him.

21.1: I will bless the LORD continually; my lips will praise you continually.
21.2: My soul will boast in the LORD, and the oppressed will hear and rejoice.
21.3: Let us magnify the LORD with me and exalt his name together.
21.4: I sought the LORD, and he answered me; he delivered me from all my fears.
21.5: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him from all his troubles.
21.6: The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear him and delivers them.
21.7: Taste and see that the LORD is good; blessed is the one who takes refuge in him.
21.8: Fear the LORD, you saints, for he who fears him lacks nothing.
21.9: Young lions may be poor and hungry, but those who seek the LORD will not lack any good thing.

22.1: Do not fret because of those who do evil, and do not be envious of those who practice iniquity.
22.2: For they will be quickly cut down like the grass, and will wither like the green herb.
22.3: Trust in the LORD and do good; let his faithfulness be your food while you remain on earth.
22.4: Delight yourself also in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
22.5: Commit your way to the LORD; trust in him, and he will do it.
22.6: He will make your righteousness shine like the light, your righteousness like the noonday light.
22.7: Be quiet before the Lord and wait patiently.
22.8: Do not fret because of someone who prospers in his way and whose evil plans come to fruition.
22.9: Cease your anger, forsake wrath, and do not complain, for this only brings about evil.

23.1: Judge me, O God; plead my cause against an ungodly nation;
23.2: Deliver me from the treacherous and unrighteous.
23.3: You are God, my strength; why have you forsaken me?
23.4: Why do I go about mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
23.5: Send forth your light and your truth, and guide me;
23.6: Lead me to your holy mountain and to your dwelling place.
23.7: Then I will come to the altar of God, to the God of my great joy.
23.8: I will sing praises to you, O God, my God, with the harp.
23.9: Why are you cast down, O my soul, and why are you troubled within me?
23.10: Put your hope in God; I will still praise my God for his appearing and help.

24.1: God is our refuge and strength.
24.2: He is a great help in times of trouble.
24.3: Therefore, whether the earth changes, whether the mountains shake and fall into the middle of the sea, or whether the sea waters rise and roar,
24.4: We will not fear, though the mountains shake because of their overflow.
24.5: There is a stream that flows and flows to make glad the city of God, the sanctuary of the Most High.
24.6: God is in the midst of the city; it will not be shaken. God will help at dawn.
24.7: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth.
24.8: He breaks the bow, breaks the spear, and burns the chariot.
24.9: He said, “Be still and know that I am God.”
24.10: I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted among the earth.
24.11: The LORD Almighty is with us.
24.12: The God of Jacob is our refuge.

25.1: Clap your hands and shout to God with joyful voices, all you peoples!
25.2: The Lord Most High is awesome and a great king over all the earth.
25.3: The LORD will subject all peoples to us and nations under our feet.
25.4: He chooses an inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob, whom he loved.
25.5: God ascends with shouts of joy; the LORD ascends with the sound of a trumpet.
25.6: Praise, praise God, praise, praise our King.
25.7: Praise God with psalms of wisdom, for he is King of all the earth.
25.8: God reigns over the people, and God sits on his holy throne.
25.9: The princes of the nations are gathered together to become the people of the God of Abraham.
25.10: All the shields of the earth are God's; he will be exalted.

26.1: Hear, my people; I will speak; I will testify to you, O Israel. I am God, your God.
26.2: I will not rebuke you because of your offerings; for your burnt offerings are always before me.
26.3: I will not take a bull from your house or a goat from your fold.
26.4: The beasts of the forest and the cattle of the mountains are mine.
26.5: All the birds of the mountains are mine, and the beasts of the field are mine.
26.6: Even if I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world and everything in it are mine.
26.7: Shall I eat the flesh of a bull, and drink the blood of a goat?
26.8: Offer thanksgiving to God and pay your vows to the Most High.
26.9: Call on me in the day of trouble, and I will deliver you, and you will glorify me.

27.1: Be gracious to me, O God, according to your lovingkindness.
27.2: According to your abundant mercy, erase my iniquities.
27.3: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquities and cleanse me of my sins.
27.4: For I know my transgressions, and my sin is always before me.
27.5: Against you alone have I sinned, and done evil in your sight.
27.6: You will be righteous when you speak; you will be blameless when you judge.
27.7: For I was born in iniquity;
27.8: In sin my mother conceived me.
27.9: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean.
27.10: Wash away my sins, so that I may be whiter than snow.
27.11: Create in me a pure heart, O God;
27.12: Renew a righteous spirit within me

28.1: O God, you are my God; earnestly I seek you.
28.2: My soul thirsts for you, my body longs for you, in a dry and weary land where there is no water.
28.3: That I may see your power and glory
28.4: Thus I looked upon thee in the sanctuary.
28.5: Your lovingkindness is better than life.
28.6: My lips will praise the Lord.
28.7: For this reason I will praise you all the days of my life.
28.8: I lift up my hands for your name’s sake
28.11: My mouth will praise you with joyful lips; I will remember you in my bed.
28.12: In the morning, when I meditate on your words in a quiet voice, you have been my help.
28.13: I will call joyfully in the shadow of your wings.

29.1: Praise, O God, awaits thee in Zion.
29.2: A person will fulfill his vow to you.
29.3: O Lord, you hear prayer, all flesh will come to you.
29.4: Iniquity has overcome me; you will forgive our transgressions.
29.5: The Lord chose me and brought me near.
29.6: Blessed is the man whom you have given to dwell in your courts.
29.7: We will be satisfied with the beauty of your house and your temple.
29.8: He takes care of the land, waters it and makes it very fruitful.
29.9: Let the rivers of God be filled with water.
29.10: After you have prepared the land, you give them grain.
29.11: The pastures were clothed with flocks, and the valleys were covered with grain.
29.12: They all shout and sing for joy.

30.1: God is gracious to us and blesses us and makes his face shine on us.
30.2: Make your ways known on earth and your salvation among all nations.
30.3: Let the nations praise you, O God;
30.5: Let all the people sing for joy and joy.
30.6: For you will judge the nations righteously and rule over the kingdoms of the earth.
30.7: Let the nations praise you, O God; let all nations praise you.
30.8: God, our God, will bless us, because the earth has yielded its produce.
30.10: All the ends of the earth will fear God.

31.1: God arises and the enemies are scattered.
31.2: Those who hate you will flee from your presence.
31.4: Just as wheat melts before the fire, let the wicked perish before God.
31.5: Let the righteous rejoice and leap before God; let them be glad and be glad.
31.6: Sing to God and praise his name.
31.7: Make a highway for him who rode in the sky and walked in the wilderness.
31.8: His name is Jehovah; leap before him.
31.9: God is a father to the fatherless and a judge to widows in his holy dwelling place.
31.10: God lets the lonely live with their families.
31.11: He brings out the prisoners and makes them prosper.
31.12: But the abode of the rebellious is a dry land.
31.13: O God, you have prepared your favor for the poor.

32.1: O LORD, in you I put my trust; do not let me be put to shame forever.
32.2: Deliver me in your righteousness; release me; incline your ear to me and save me.
32.3: Be the rock to which I always take refuge; you have commanded me to be saved.
32.4: For you are my rock and my fortress.
32.5: O my God, help me escape from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unjust and the wicked.
32.6: Lord GOD, you are my hope, in whom I have trusted from my youth.
32.7: From my mother's womb I have trusted in you; from my mother's womb you have chosen me.

33.1: Give the king your judgment, O God, and your righteousness to your son.
33.2: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.
33.3: By righteousness the mountains will give peace to the people, and so will the hills.
33.4: He will bring justice to the poor people; he will save the children of the needy; he will break the oppressors.
33.5: They will fear you while the sun is, and while the moon is, from generation to generation.
33.6: He will fall like rain on the cut grass, like showers that water the earth.
33.7: The righteous will multiply in his days, and peace will abound until the months end.
33.8: He will rule from sea to sea, and from the rivers to the ends of the earth.
33.9: All kings will bow down before him, and all nations will serve him.

34.1: Sing joyfully to God our strength; shout joyfully to the God of Jacob.
34.2: Recite poetry, play the tambourine, and play the harp on the beautiful lyre.
34.3: Blow the trumpet on the first day and the first full moon and on our holidays.
34.4: This is a statute for Israel and a statute for the God of Jacob.
34.5: God set this as a testimony among the house of Joseph when he went against the land of Egypt.
34.6: There I heard a word I did not know.
34.7: And he said, I will lift the burden from his shoulders;
34.8: And the basket was taken out of his hand.
34.9: In your distress you cried out, and I delivered you.
34.10: I answered you in the secret place of the thunder; I tested you by the waters of Meribah.
34.11: Hear, my people, and I will testify to you; listen to me, O Israel.
34.12: You shall not have any strange gods among you, nor bow down to foreign gods.
34.13: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt; open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.
34.14: My people did not listen to my voice, and Israel did not want me.

35.1: How lovely is your tabernacle, O LORD Almighty!
35.2: My soul faints with longing for the courts of the LORD.
35.3: My heart and body cry out to the living God.
35.4: O LORD Almighty, my King and my God
35.5: Even the sparrow has found a home at your altar, and the swallow a nest where she may lay her young.
35.6: Blessed are those who live in Your house, for they will always praise You.
35.7: Blessed is he whose strength is in the Lord, and whose heart is the highways of Zion.
35.8: As they passed through the vale of tears
35.9: There will be many springs there, and the former rain will fill you with blessings.
35.10: One day in your courts is better than a thousand elsewhere.
35.11: I would rather be a gatekeeper in the temple of my God than to dwell in the tents of the wicked.
35.12: Blessed is he who trusts in Thee, O LORD Almighty.

36.1: Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.
36.2: Before the mountains were created, before you formed the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.
36.3: You turned people to dust and said, “Return, you people!”
36.4: A thousand years are in your sight like yesterday, a moment in the night.
36.5: You sweep them away like a flood; they are like a sleep, like the grass that sprouts in the morning.
36.6: The grass blooms and grows in the morning, but withers and dries in the evening.
36.7: We are consumed by your wrath, we are astonished at your wrath.
36.8: You have set our iniquities before you; you have set our secret sins in the light of your countenance.
36.9: All our days pass away in thy wrath, and all our days come to an end in a moment.
36.10: Our years are seventy, and if we are strong we are eighty; yet their boast is only toil and sorrow; they pass quickly, and we fly away.
36.11: Who knows the power of Your wrath, and who knows the fear of Your wrath?

37.1: Dwelling in the secret place of the Most High

38.1: Give thanks to the LORD, O Most High, with the strings of strings, the lyre, and the lyre; praise your name.

40.1: Sing to the LORD a new song; sing to the LORD, all the earth.
40.2: Sing to the Lord, bless his name; proclaim his salvation daily.
40.3: Declare his glory among the people, his wondrous deeds among all peoples.
40.4: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but the Lord made the heavens.
40.5: Honor and majesty are before him;
40.6: Power and beauty are in his sanctuary.
40.7: Worship the Lord with beautiful and holy things.
40.8: Tremble before him, all the earth!
40.9: The heavens rejoice, the earth rejoices, the sea and its fullness shout;

41.1: The LORD reigns; let the earth rejoice, let the islands be glad.
41.2: Clouds and darkness surround him; righteousness and judgment are the foundation of his throne.
41.3: Fire comes out from before him and consumes his enemies on every side.
41.4: His lightning illuminated the world, and the earth saw it and trembled.
41.5: The mountains melted like wax before the Lord, before the Lord of all the earth.
41.6: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.
41.7: All who serve carved images and boast about vanity will be put to shame. Worship the LORD, you gods.
41.8: Zion rejoiced, O LORD, when she heard your judgments; the daughters of Judah rejoiced.
41.9: For you, O LORD, are most exalted over all the earth; you are above all gods.
41.10: Hate evil, you who love the LORD, for he preserves the souls of his saints, delivering them out of the hand of the wicked.
41.11: He sows light for the righteous and joy for those who are upright in heart.
41.12: Rejoice in the LORD, O righteous ones, and give thanks to his holy name.

42.1: Sing praises to the LORD with a new song, for he has done wondrous things.
42.2: For by his right hand and holy arm he hath provided salvation for himself.
42.3: The LORD makes his salvation known;
42.4: He has made His righteousness plain in the sight of all nations.
42.5: For he remembered his kindness and faithfulness toward the house of Israel.
42.6: All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
42.7: Shout for joy to the LORD, all the earth!
42.8: Sing and praise out loud for joy.
42.9: Sing to the Lord on the harp
42.11: Shout for joy before the Lord, the King, with trumpets and whistles.
42.12: Let the sea and all that is in it cry out, the world and all who dwell in it.
42.13: Let the waters applaud before the LORD; let the mountains sing joyfully together.

43.1: The Lord reigns, and all peoples will tremble.
43.2: The LORD sits between the cherubim, and the earth shakes.
43.3: Great is the LORD in Zion, and above all nations.
43.4: Praise be to the great and awesome name of the Lord, for he is holy.
43.5: A mighty king loves justice; the Lord establishes justice.
43.6: You bring justice and righteousness to Jacob.
43.7: Exalt the LORD our God and worship him at his footstool.
43.9: Moses and Aaron are among his priests, and Samuel is among those who call on his name.
43.10: They sought the LORD, and he answered them.
43.11: The LORD spoke to them from the pillar of cloud.
43.12: And they kept the testimonies and the statutes which he gave them.
43.13: O LORD our God, you have answered them;
43.14: You, God, rewarded them according to their deeds, but forgave them.
43.15: Exalt the LORD our God and worship him in his holy mountain.
43.16: The LORD our God is holy.

44.1: Sing joyful praise to the LORD, all the earth!
44.2: Serve the LORD with joy and come before him with singing.
44.3: Know ye that the LORD is our God.
44.4: It is he who made us, and we are his, his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
44.5: Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise.
44.6: Give thanks to him and bless his name.
44.7: The LORD is good; his love endures forever.
44.8: His faithfulness endures throughout all generations.

45.1: Praise the Lord, O my soul.
45.2: Bless his holy name, all that is within me.
45.3: Praise the LORD, O my soul, and do not forget all his benefits.
45.4: He forgives all your iniquities and heals all your diseases.
45.5: He redeems your life from destruction and crowns you with lovingkindness and compassion.
45.6: He satisfies your desires with good things, so that your youth is renewed like that of the eagle.
45.7: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger and abundant in love.
45.8: He will not often rebuke, nor will he keep his anger forever.
45.9: He did not punish us according to our sins, nor did He repay us according to our iniquities.
45.10: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his love for those who fear him.
45.11: He removed our transgressions from us as far as the east is from the west.
45.12: As a father shows mercy to his children, so the LORD shows compassion to those who fear him.
45.13: For he knows our constitution, remembering that we are but dust.

46.1: Bless the LORD, O my soul, O LORD my God.
46.2: You are very great; you are clothed with honor and authority.
46.3: You clothe yourself with light like a garment; you spread the heavens like a curtain.
46.4: He laid the beams of his pavilion on the waters, and made the clouds his chariot.
46.5: He walks on the wings of the wind, making the winds his ambassadors and the flames of fire his ministers.
46.6: You laid a foundation on the earth that will never be moved.
46.7: You have set boundaries for the waters, so that they do not overflow.
46.8: He did not allow us to return again and cover the earth.
46.9: The LORD caused springs to spring up in the valleys and run through the mountains.
46.10: He gives drink to every wild beast, and even the wild donkeys are thirsty.
46.11: The birds of the air make their nest by it.
46.13: He poured water on the mountain from his pavilion.
46.14: The fruit of your works satisfies the earth.

47.1: Give thanks to the LORD, call on his name, let his works be known among all people.
47.2: Sing to him, praise him, tell all his wonderful works.
47.3: Boast in his holy name. May the hearts of those who seek the Lord rejoice.
47.4: Seek the LORD and his strength; seek his face always.
47.5: And you, descendants of Abraham his servant, sons of Jacob whom he chose, remember the miracles he did, his signs, and the judgments of his mouth.
47.6: He is the LORD our God; his judgment is in all the earth.
47.7: He has remembered forever his covenant, which he commanded for a thousand generations.
47.8: This is the covenant with Abraham and the oath to Isaac.
47.9: The statute for Jacob, the everlasting covenant for Israel.
47.10: He said, “I will give you the land of Canaan to be your possession.”

48.1: Remember me, O LORD, with the favor you show to your people.
48.2: Take care of me with your salvation
48.3: May I see your chosen ones prosper and share in the joy of your kingdom.
48.4: Let us boast of Your heritage
48.5: We have sinned like our fathers did;
48.6: I have done evil and committed evil.
48.7: Our fathers did not understand your wondrous works while they were in Egypt.
48.8: We did not remember your great love, but rebelled at the sea, the Red Sea.
48.9: But the LORD saved them for his name's sake.
48.10: That His great power may be known to all people.
48.11: Then he rebuked the Red Sea, and immediately it dried up. He led them through the sea as if they were passing through the wilderness.
48.12: He saved them from the hand of those who hated them and saved them from the hand of their enemies.
48.13: He covered their enemies with water, so that not one of them survived.
48.14: So they believed his word and sang a song of praise to him.

49.1: O God, I have made up my mind
49.2: I will sing and praise with all my heart.
49.5: I give thanks to you, O LORD, of all people;
49.6: I will praise you among all nations.
49.7: Your love is higher than the heavens.
49.8: Your truth extends to the heavens.
49.9: You, O God, are exalted above the heavens;
49.10: May your glory be exalted in all the earth.
49.11: Answer us and save with your right hand to save those you love.

50.1: I love the LORD, because he hears my voice and my prayers.
50.2: His ear is attentive to me; I will pray all the days of my life.
50.3: When the bands of death compassed me, and the torment of Sheol came upon me, I was in trouble and sorrow.
50.4: I prayed in the name of the LORD, “I pray to you, O LORD, deliver my soul.”
50.5: The LORD is gracious and righteous; our God is merciful.
50.6: The LORD protects the innocent; he saved me when I was in trouble.
50.7: Return to your peace, my soul, for the LORD has dealt well with you.
50.8: Thou hast delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
50.9: How shall I repay the Lord for all the favors He has given me?
50.10: I take the cup of salvation and call on the name of the Lord
50.11: I will pay my vow to the LORD before all his people.
50.12: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his godly ones.

51.1: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his love endures forever.
51.2: Now let Israel say, His love endures forever.
51.3: Now let the house of Aaron say, “His mercy endures forever.”
51.4: Now let them that fear the LORD say, His steadfast love endureth for ever.
51.5: In my distress I cried to the LORD, and the LORD answered me; he set me in a spacious place.
51.6: The LORD is on my side; I will not fear. What can man do to me?
51.7: The LORD is on my side and among those who help me.
51.8: Therefore I will see vengeance on those who hate me.
51.9: It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to trust in men. It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to trust in princes.
51.10: The nations have surrounded me; I will cut them off in the name of the Lord.
51.11: You pushed me to fall, but the LORD helped me.
51.12: The LORD is my strength and praise, and he has become my salvation.

52.1: How can a young man purify his way? He only keeps your word.
52.2: I seek you with all my heart; let me not turn away from your commandments.
52.3: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I may not sin against you.
52.4: Teach me your statutes, O Lord, blessed be the Lord.
52.5: I will mute on Your precepts; I will pay attention to Your ways.
52.6: I will delight in your statutes, and I will not forget your word.
52.7: If your law had not been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.
52.8: I will never forget your precepts; for by them you give me life.
52.9: Save me, for I am yours; for I have sought only your precepts.
52.10: The wicked watch to destroy me, but I will consider Your testimonies.
52.11: I saw that every perfection has an end, but your commandments are very broad.
52.12: How I love your law! I meditate on it all day long.

53.1: I lift up my eyes to the mountains; whence will my help come?
53.2: My help comes from the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
53.3: The LORD will not let you stumble, and he who watches over you will not slumber.
53.4: He who watches over Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
53.5: The LORD is your keeper; the LORD is your shade at your right hand.
53.6: The sun will not harm you by day, nor will the moon by night harm you.
53.7: The LORD will keep you from all trouble, and he will guard your soul.
53.8: The LORD will guard your coming out and your coming out from now on and forevermore.

54.1: It was as if we were dreaming, when the LORD brought back the captives of Zion.
54.2: Then our mouth was full of laughter, and our tongue with praise.
54.3: At that time it was said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
54.4: We rejoice, for the LORD has done great things for us.
54.5: O LORD, return our captives like the streams of the south.
54.6: Those who sow seeds in tears will reap with joy.
54.7: He who goes out weeping to sow will surely return with joy, bringing with him sheaves of grain.

55.1: Unless the LORD builds the house, those who build it labor in vain.
55.2: Unless the LORD guards the city, the watchman stays awake in vain.
55.3: It is in vain that you rise early and lie down late, eating the bread of your toil.
55.4: Therefore the LORD gives sleep to those whom he loves.
55.5: Behold, the children are an inheritance from the Lord;
55.6: The fruit of the womb is his reward.
55.7: The children of a young man are like arrows in the hand of a merchant.
55.8: Blessed is he whose quiver is full of these.
55.9: They will not be put to shame when they argue with their enemies in the gate.

56.1: Blessed is everyone who fears the Lord and walks in his ways.
56.2: You will eat from the toil of your hands; you will be blessed and prosper.
56.3: Your wife is like a fruitful vine in your inner chamber;
56.4: The children around your table will be like young olive trees.
56.5: So will those who fear the LORD be blessed.
56.6: May the Lord bless you from Zion.
56.7: May you see Jerusalem prosper and your children’s children all the days of your life.

57.1: Out of the depths I cried to you, O LORD.
57.2: Lord, hear my voice and give ear to my cry.
57.3: O LORD, if you watch over iniquity,
57.5: But forgiveness is with the Lord.
57.7: I, my soul, wait for the LORD;
57.9: My soul waits for you more than the watchman waits for the morning.
57.10: Truly more than a watchman waiting for the morning.
57.11: Hope in the Lord, O Israel
57.12: For with the Lord is lovingkindness and abundant redemption.
57.13: He will redeem Israel from all her iniquities.

58.1: Behold, brothers dwell together in unity.
58.3: The precious oil on the head
58.4: It was like a stream running down the beard of Aaron, down to the collar of his clothes.
58.5: As the dew of Hermon comes down on the mountains of Zion.

59.1: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his love endures forever.
59.2: Give thanks to God, who is excellent among gods, for his love endures forever.

59.4: Give thanks to him who alone works great wonders, for his love endures forever.
59.5: Give thanks to him who made the heavens with wisdom, for his love endures forever.
59.6: Give thanks to him who spread the earth on the waters, for his love endures forever.
59.7: Give thanks to him who made the great lights, for his love endures forever.
59.8: Give thanks to him who makes the sun rule the day, for his love endures forever.
59.9: Give thanks to him who made the moon and stars to rule the night, for his love endures forever.
59.10: Give thanks to him who struck down the firstborn of Egypt, for his love endures forever.
59.11: Give thanks to him who brought Israel out of their midst, for his love endures forever.
59.12: Give thanks to him who led you with a strong hand and an outstretched arm, for his love endures forever.

60.1: You have searched me, O LORD, and you know me.
60.2: You know when I sit and when I rise; you know my thoughts from afar.
60.3: You have observed all my ways and my lying down; you are acquainted with all my ways.
60.4: O LORD, there is nothing on my tongue that you do not know.

60.6: If I ascend to heaven, you are there; if I make my bed in Sheol, you are there.
60.7: Even if I take the wings of the morning and dwell at the ends of the sea,
60.8: There also your hand will lead me, your right hand will uphold me.
60.9: Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my thoughts.
60.10: See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the path everlasting.

61.2: They cry out loud in supplication to the LORD.
61.3: I will pour out my grievances before him.

61.8: No one cares for my soul
61.9: I cried to thee, O LORD, and said,

61.12: Deliver me from those who persecute me, for they are stronger than I.

62.6: Therefore my spirit is broken within me, and my heart is sorrowful within me.

62.10: Revive me, O LORD, for your name’s sake, and bring my soul out of trouble in your righteousness.
62.11: Cut off my enemies in your lovingkindness.
62.12: Destroy all who afflict my soul, for I am your servant.

63.1: I will exalt you, O King my God, and will bless your name forever.
63.2: I will bless you every day; I will praise your name forever.

63.6: Men will speak of the power of Your awesome works, and I will declare Your greatness.
63.7: They will speak of your great favor and sing of your righteousness.

67.1: Blessed are those who find wisdom and understanding.

70.1: Behold my servant, whom I uphold, in whom my heart delights, whom I have chosen.
70.2: I have given him my spirit; he will bring justice to the nations.

71.7: Give ear, and come unto me, and hear.

71.10: This is the sure grace granted to David.

72.6: Your righteousness will go before you, and the glory of the LORD will surround you behind you.
72.7: When you call, I, the LORD, will answer.
72.8: When you call, you will say, ‘Here I am.’
